Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back. The players and the match officials return to the ground. Kushal Bhurtel and Aasif Sheikh are the openers for Nepal. Junaid Siddique is to bowl the first over...
... CHASE BEGINS ...

Looking ahead - 146 might not seem like a challenging target but UAE have momentum with them and they do possess a bowling lineup that can do well in these conditions. Nepal will be fairly confident of chasing this one down, especially with the dew likely to settle in as well, but a couple of early wickets could make things really interesting. Stay tuned as the run chase is up next.

Recovery act - UAE will feel they have gotten out of jail here. They were 60/3 after 10 overs, which quickly became 66/5 in 11.3 overs, and only Aryansh Sharma had played a knock of any substance till then. Then came the stand between Sohaib Khan and Harshit Kaushik that turned things around for UAE. The duo stitched together a 68-run stand before Kaushik got out on 35. Khan finished off with an unbeaten 38 off 27 balls as UAE picked up 65 runs in the last 5 overs.

Spin is King, for Nepal - Nepal might not have been able to close things out strongly with the ball but their spinners bowled really well. Even Karan KC started well with the big wicket of the UAE skipper in the first over but couldn't quite keep things tight at the death. Sandeep Lamichhane was the pick of the bowlers as he got two wickets but the likes of Sher Malla and Dipendra Singh Airee too did a fine job. Overall, they will look to work a bit more on their death bowling.

Trading blows - The first 20 overs of this contest have provided us with plenty of action and after a solid showing with the ball from Nepal for about 15 or so overs, UAE have finished really strongly. However, 145 still feels 10-15 runs short of a par score and Nepal would have gladly taken this score at the toss.

A couple of runs to end the innings! Nandan Yadav bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Sohaib Khan tries to pull but gets a top edge that falls safely in the vacant short fine region. The fielder from the deep runs in and throws it to the keeper, who takes the bails off, but Khan puts in an excellent dive to get inside the crease. United Arab Emirates finish on 145/6.
